scope_policy.answerable_domain: facts explicitly supported by approved pages from Koehler's Medizinal-Pflanzen
scope_policy.external_sources: may supply names, aliases and Taiwan occurrence metadata only; never plant facts in the answer

rules: If a Taiwan public plant name exists, it remains the canonical display label even in an English answer.
Keep scientific_name as the cross-source identity and show it with the Taiwan name on first mention in English.
A simplified-Chinese name is never canonical when any Taiwan or other authoritative Traditional-Chinese name exists.
Materia-medica names and botanical display names are separate fields linked through the scientific taxon.
